name: Theranos
description: We are revolutionizing blood testing by running over 200 health tests on a single drop of capillary blood from a fingerprick, using our proprietary Edison device. This completely eliminates the need for large venous draws and expensive centralized lab equipment.
critical_physics_flaw: Capillary blood from fingerpricks is heavily diluted with interstitial fluid and cells burst during collection. You cannot run 200 distinct assays on 50 microliters of blood due to basic fluid volume limits.

name: Lilium
description: An electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) jet using 36 small ducted fans. We project a range of 300km at 300km/h carrying 7 passengers, utilizing standard lithium-ion batteries available today without relying on unproven solid-state chemistry.
critical_physics_flaw: Ducted fans have high disc loading, requiring massive hover power. Standard Li-ion batteries (250 Wh/kg) lack the energy density to provide necessary hover reserves and 300km forward flight range. Physics dictates they will run out of power.

name: Generic Hydrogen
description: Our novel electrolyzer stack produces green hydrogen at €1.20/kg. We assume an electricity input price of €0.02/kWh running 24/7. We use proprietary non-precious metal catalysts to lower CapEx to €300/kW.
critical_physics_flaw: €0.02/kWh electricity is not available 24/7 on any European grid. If you rely on intermittent solar, you cannot run 24/7, driving up levelized CapEx.

name: Proven SaaS
description: A B2B SaaS platform that automates accounts payable reconciliation using OCR and standard machine learning classifiers. We charge $500/month per enterprise seat and have $2M ARR with 85% gross margins.
